00035 /**
00036  * @brief               Create a listbox widget
00037  *
00038  * HxListBoxNew creates a new listbox widget.
00039  *
00040  * The height of pRect is the maximum height of the control.  Additional
00041  * strings are accessed by scrolling through the list.  HxListBoxGetBounds
00042  * can be called before creating the listbox in order to pass in an
00043  * appropriately sized rectangle.
00044  *
00045  * HxListSetColor and HxListSetFont can be used to customize the look of a
00046  * listbox.
00047  *
00048  * @param id            IN:     Unique ID for the widget, defined by app,
00049  *                              or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
00050  * @param pParent       IN:     Pointer to "parent" widget
00051  * @param pBounds       IN:     Pointer to rectangle describing the position
00052  *                              and size of the control
00053  * @param hText         IN:     Pointer to the array of strings
00054  * @param count         IN:     Count of strings in hText
00055  * @param hListBox      OUT:    Handle to the created listbox, NULL on
00056  *                              failure
00057  *
00058  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.  Returns
00059  *                              HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails.
00060  *
00061  **/
00062 HxResult HxListBoxNew(uint32_t id, HxWidget_t* pParent, 
00063                         const HxRectangle_t* pBounds,
00064                         const char* const* hText, int32_t count,
00065                         HxListBox_t** hListBox);
00066 
00067 /**
00068  * @brief               Delete a list widget
00069  
00070  * HxListBoxDelete deletes a list created from an earlier call to
00071  * HxListBoxNew.
00072  *
00073  * It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application,
00074  * since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is
00075  * deleted.  HxListBoxDelete only needs to be called when removing a
00076  * list at runtime.
00077  *
00078  * @param pListBox      IN:     Pointer to the list to delete
00079  *
00080  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.
00081  *
00082  **/
00083 HxResult HxListBoxDelete(HxListBox_t* pListBox);
